public_demo_source: PhysioNet; files downloaded with SHA256 verification
limitations: This is one GitHub Actions run, not a statistically powered multi-host benchmark.
The baseline SQLite table stores JSON text and is not a feature-equivalent normalized relational database design.
MongoDB is accessed through PyMongo localhost socket, whereas SQLite is accessed in-process: the cost models and network/client layers differ.
The workload is a narrow indexed as-of event retrieval task; no inference on universal database performance.
storetime_proxy is not proof of clinician visibility. The source demo does not yield valid clinical timing effect estimates.
